content:
Mia: Quick heads-up — planning an anchor swap in the model catalog tonight at 21:00 UTC. We’re moving alias `prod-anchor` from aurelia-3.5b to aurelia-3.5b-quant. Canary window ~20m. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness?
Juan: I can own smoke checks. I’ll be on at 20:50 UTC. What exact checks do we want?
Mia: thanks Juan. Minimal smoke: 1) sanity generation (short prompt) 2) latency check (p95 < 450ms) 3) embedding vector sanity for a small set 4) TLS + auth check. Run these against the canary alias.
Sasha: infra question — are we doing a gradual traffic shift or instant alias swap? gradual would need routing config change.
Mia: plan is immediate alias swap to cutover, because the quantized variant needs a quick verification. But we’ll keep automatic fallback to non-quant variant for 10m if errors > 2%.
Oliver: capacity note: Dedicated pool has 4 nodes free in eu-west-1, warmup ~5m. Recommend start deploy at 20:50 so model is warmed before 21:00.
Zoe: PR #4821 (catalog: add aurelia-3.5b-quant entry + pin) merged earlier today. I added the compatibility tags and a note about KV-cache policy.
Pranay: Rollback play: revert alias to previous model ID + trigger warmup on previous variant, then clear prefix cache if we see stale scoring. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-pin-rollback (follow steps 2-4).
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: aurelia-3.5b-quant -> prod-anchor at 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z. Triggered by @Mia. CI checks: passed.
Juan: smoke script I’ll run (small snippet):
```
# smoke.sh
curl -s -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"prod-anchor","input":"Hello there"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate | jq '.choices[0].text'
```
Juan: will also run the latency harness: `python infra/tools/latency_probe.py --target prod-anchor --qps 5 --duration 120`
Sasha: FYI I’ll monitor tracing and error rate dashboards during the canary. If errors spike >2% for 5m, we revert.
Zoe: One note — please disable the prefix cache warming (cache_warm=false) for the canary run so we test cold-start behavior. We added a toggle in the catalog entry.
Mia: good call. Also @Juan, after smoke, please run the quick eval set (10 prompts) in `eng-ml/evals/aurelia_quick.json` and paste a short summary (3 bullets) in this thread.
Juan: will do. ETA after smoke ~21:25 UTC.
Pranay: ops checklist before swap: confirm PR merged, confirm capacity, confirm fallback routing enabled, confirm runbook on hand, confirm post-mortem stub created. I’ll be on-call if rollback needed.
Oliver: infra will start instance spin at 20:45 UTC. Tagging nodes with `canary-aurelia-quant`.
Zoe: small caveat — quant variant returns slightly different tokenization for a couple of edge cases. I added a note in the catalog metadata. We should watch embedding similarity drift as well.
Mia: thanks all. Final owner list: deploy infra = Oliver, smoke & evals = Juan, monitoring = Sasha, rollback lead = Pranay, catalog metadata steward = Zoe. Leave reactions here once you ack. :thumbsup:
Juan: ack :thumbsup:
Sasha: ack :thumbsup:
Oliver: ack :thumbsup:
Zoe: ack :thumbsup:
Pranay: ack :thumbsup:
Mia: I’ll post a quick summary in #product after we’re green. If anyone can’t make the window, shout now.
Zoe: small follow-up — please remember to set `pin_reason=quant-benchmark` in the alias update so audits capture why this pin happened.
Mia: noted. Thanks team — see you at 20:50 UTC.
